notes: NORTHBROWN 2.0.12 fixes the Smart Finder UI so 500, 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000 targets plus Overnight mode are visible even when an older cached app.js was being served. It cache-busts the static UI files and force-upgrades the Smart Finder controls. It also adds ChatGPT Import inside every prospect: copy a business-specific ChatGPT scan prompt, then drag a .northbrown.json/.json scan back onto that prospect to replace the NORTHBROWN scan score, summary, issues, strengths and sales angle with the imported evidence-led result. A second prompt creates a completely unique static website demo; .html or .zip demos can be dropped into the same panel, stored against that business and opened or downloaded from its prospect record. Imported website previews run sandboxed and imports do not overwrite prospect contact data. The OTA is self-contained, starts from the updater-created 2.0.11 backup, compiles touched Python before commit, preserves data/settings, and automatically rolls back on migration failure.
